rubric.evidence: Every signature is verbatim from Blink IDL fetched 2026-08-09 (navigator_web_install.idl, install_params.idl, web_install_result.idl); error taxonomy and thrown-vs-rejected split read directly from navigator_web_install.cc (CheckPreconditionsMaybeThrow / InstallImpl / InstallFromParamsImpl / OnInstallResponse); algorithms quoted from the explainer's Steps-to-install sections and the w3c/manifest#1175 diff; permission gating from permission_utils.cc; policy default from permissions_policy_features.json5. The listing-vs-source availability contradiction (listing says Enabled by default; branch flag is status:test; API record says In development) is disclosed in the warn-block rather than resolved by guesswork.

Folder v153/web-install-api matches the milestone=153 listing entry (id 5183481574850560, listing name "Web Install API", category "Enabled by default", verified 2026-08-09); slug derived from the listing name per repo slugify rules; prior OT milestones (143-150) are documented as history, not used for filing.

reference-contract.json declares 5 inventory items (method with 4 overloads, InstallParams, WebInstallResult, web-app-installation permission, web-app-installation policy directive) x 9 dimensions; the substantial member navigator.install() has a stable child route install/ carrying syntax/parameters/return-value/exceptions/context/lifecycle/examples/compatibility/security. Two not-applicable dimensions carry sourced rationales. Self-assessed implementation-sufficient pending integrator review.

The current-document vs background-document model is explained before the syntax; the manifest-id identity rule gets its own treatment (the API's main developer trap per the OT experiment goals); the deprecated install_url overloads are documented but flagged with the removal bug so readers write new code against the dictionary shape; spec-vs-implementation divergences (Promise<undefined> vs Promise<WebInstallResult>, spec's [[installPromise]] slot) are stated explicitly.

Overview: feature-detected current-document install button and an app-catalog background install with full error handling. Child page: the same two flows plus a permissions.query pre-check wrapped in try/catch (permission_utils.cc throws TypeError when the feature is off). All snippets adapted from the explainer/OT-README with error names cross-checked against the implementation; both official demo sites linked. No CPS iframe: the showcase route 404s (2026-08-09), stated honestly.

No BCD entry (api/Navigator.json checked) and webstatus.dev navigator-install lists no implementations (both verified 2026-08-09), so compat tables are labelled interim and compiled from the milestone listing, branch flag state, OT records, and both vendor position issues; feature-detection guidance ('install' in navigator plus try/catch on permissions.query) is given for fallback.

All citations are direct links: Blink IDL/impl files, runtime_enabled_features.json5 at trunk AND branch-heads/7978, about_flags.cc, fieldtrial config, w3c/manifest#1175, explainer, OT README + registration page, three blink-dev threads (prototype msgid, dev-trial, I2E, plus the extension msgid), TAG review, both standards-positions issues, three crbugs. The docs.google.com design doc on the ChromeStatus record was deliberately not cited (access-restricted). Zero unlinked source labels.

Single h1 per page with sequential h2/h3 outline; all data tables use th scope with header rows; the baseline banner uses role=note with aria-label; code examples are real text in pre/code; colors come exclusively from the shared stylesheet variables (WCAG AA per repo invariant #5); links are descriptive, not bare 'here'.

h1/lede and inline code carry overflow-wrap:anywhere for long URLs and flag names; every table sits in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table-layout:fixed and a min-width floor; pre blocks scroll internally; 1280px screenshots of both routes rendered and read; no fixed pixel widths beyond min-width guards.

The CPS feature route /v153/web-install-api/ returned 404 on 2026-08-09 (verified with curl -o /dev/null -w %{http_code}), so no iframe is embedded; the page links the showcase feature URL as pending plus the two official Microsoft demos as runnable material. Upgrade to an embed is a follow-up goal.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables code blocks long tokens mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on the browser layout engine and intrinsic sizing before hardcoded dimensions; keep overflow contained per container (flex/grid items and long unbreakable content need min-size/overflow handling so they do not spill on narrow viewports).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: tables render inside .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table-layout:fixed and min-width floors so the page body never scrolls horizontally; pre blocks scroll internally; overflow-wrap:anywhere on headings, lede, and inline code for long URLs/flag names; route cards use auto-fit minmax grid.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status banner warning callout semantics reference page
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place content in landmarks with a sequential heading outline; use semantic tables with caption/th scoping; prefer native HTML semantics to ARIA and never fake headings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: main landmark with h1 then sequential h2/h3; th scope on all row/column headers; baseline banner as role=note with aria-label instead of a fake alert; warn-block heading is a strong intro inside the callout, keeping the h2 outline clean; code snippets are text, not images.

openQuestions: What actually enables WebAppInstallation in stable 153? The runtime feature is status:test on branch-heads/7978, base_feature_status:enabled with copied_from_base_feature_if:overridden, no fieldtrial_testing_config entry, no public Intent-to-Ship thread found, and the ChromeStatus browser status still reads 'In development' (all 2026-08-09) — consistent with a Finch-driven rollout that is not visible in public source. Re-verify once M153 reaches stable and update the warn-block.
When do the deprecated install_url overloads actually leave the IDL (crbug.com/520025525)? The syntax sections must be updated the moment they are removed.
Will the InstallParams overload start returning manifestId in WebInstallResult once crbug.com/520052963 resolves the disclosure question?

Does the w3c/manifest PR gain the dictionary signature (and the SecureContext/NewObject semantics Chromium enforces via preconditions), or does the API move to a different spec home given the WebApps WG venue note in the explainer?

followUpGoals.goal: Re-verify the WebAppInstallation flag state and ChromeStatus browser status at/after M153 stable promotion; update the availability warn-block, baseline banner, and compat rows once the enablement mechanism is publicly visible.
Track crbug.com/520025525 and remove/annotate the deprecated install_url overloads on both routes when they leave the trunk IDL.
When BCD gains api.Navigator.install (web-features id navigator-install), replace both interim compat tables with real per-version BCD data.
If the Chrome Platform Showcase ships /v153/web-install-api/ (or a concept sub-route), upgrade the examples sections from text links to the standard live iframe embed.
